name: Xenon
description: A granular synthesizer around a glowing waveform. Drop a sample on it, grains read it with their own pitch, envelope and filter and sound from their own place in 3D: azimuth, elevation, distance, motion and a room. Two LFOs, two envelopes, per-grain random, velocity, key, mod wheel, pressure and grain age modulate every grain parameter. Fits openDAW's device panel.
credits: Built on the CLAP headers by free-audio (MIT).
